paragraphs.text: Kerselin is a pioneer port town on the edge of the Great Wood , on Ulgrotha . It is the major producer of lumber of the plane; the lumber that it is cut here is then sailed to Aysen , or carted up on the Lady's Path to Koskun Keep .

A vessel carrying over thirty families from Onella to Kerselin was hijacked by Baron Sengir , who then used the unfortunate travelers to populate his Dark Barony . The famous archer Rashka has sworn revenge against the Baron for this heinous act.
In another occasion, the Wizard Savant Reveka sailed a loaded frigate through winter storms to deliver food to ensure Kerselin would survive until spring.
